annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear recommendation (SHOULD NOT) about when endpoints should issue updates to the Retire Prior To field. It specifies that such updates should be avoided until all connection IDs indicated by the previous Retire Prior To value have been retired via RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames. There is no language that allows for multiple materially different interpretations or missing constraints that would affect implementation behavior.
